who_we_are.description: HeatEx Direct gathers practical, up-to-date industrial information to support sourcing research for industrial heat exchangers. We help global buyers better understand Chinese manufacturers, product capabilities, and the Chinese heat exchanger market before deciding who to contact.
paragraphs: China has many heat exchanger companies with real manufacturing capability across different industrial applications. For overseas buyers, however, useful supplier information is often scattered across Chinese websites, public materials, exhibition documents, product brochures, images, and factory media.

HeatEx Direct turns that scattered information into a clearer structure for sourcing research and technical review. We focus on company background, product scope, industries served, export markets, certificates, media assets, product details, technical parameters, and application information so buyers can form a clearer view before making contact.

identity_cards.title: We are an independent information platform
identity_cards.body: We do not represent a single factory, and we do not present supplier pages as one-company advertisements. The goal is to make manufacturer information easier to review, understand, and use.

identity_cards.title: We focus only on heat exchangers
identity_cards.body: Our content is built around industrial heat exchangers, thermal transfer equipment, related product capabilities, and sourcing parameters, reducing unrelated listing noise.

identity_cards.title: We serve global industrial buyers
identity_cards.body: Procurement teams, engineers, project contractors, distributors, and system integrators can use the platform to review manufacturers and submit structured project requirements through the 'Request for Quote' form.

advantages.title: Structured Supplier Information
descriptions: Many buyers already have supplier names, but not enough structured information to understand whether those suppliers are relevant, credible, and worth deeper review.
HeatEx Direct organizes scattered supplier information into clearer sourcing material, helping buyers look beyond company introductions and sales claims before starting supplier conversations.
